defects.defect: The primary 'Play · Level 1' CTA is unframed floating text on the bare background — no button plate, border or fill, so it does not read as tappable
defects.direction: Wrap it in a wide framed CTA button (gold/green plate with dark bevel border and drop shadow) matching the top-bar/nav frame language, centered on the same vertical axis

defects.defect: Vertical rhythm is uneven: large empty gaps around the Play text and beneath the map read as unfinished dead space
defects.direction: Equalize the gaps between top bar, title, hero panel, map panel, Play button and nav bar to a single spacing unit (~32-40px)
defects.region: Between hero panel (y≈718) and map (y≈760) vs map to Play (y≈1110-1210) vs Play to nav (y≈1250-1335)

defects.defect: The map has no visible enclosing panel or route treatment, leaving a large brown field that reads unfinished.
defects.direction: Add a framed map field and a clearer connected progression path behind the locks, node, and side landmarks.

defects.defect: 'Play · Level 1' is bare text with no button plate/frame; it floats unframed on the background
defects.direction: Wrap the Play label and energy cost in a single framed button (gold/wood plate per Kingdom Rush style) centered on the vertical axis

defects.defect: “Play · Level 1” and its energy cost float as separate text/chip elements rather than reading as one primary button.
defects.direction: Place the label and cost inside one substantial, centered, framed CTA with a clear tap surface.

defects.defect: Level map has no framed panel; path nodes and decor props sit directly on the striped background, unlike the framed hero scene panel above
defects.direction: Contain the level path and decorations in a framed panel matching the hero panel's border treatment, aligned to the same width and axis

defects.defect: The level map is an unframed strip of scattered props (rocks, tent, campfire, cactus) with no panel container, unlike the framed hero panel above it
defects.direction: Place the map inside a rounded framed panel with the same border weight and corner radius as the hero panel, with matching left/right margins

defects.defect: The 'Play · Level 1' label plus energy-cost pill is left-of-center as a group; the text block and pill together shift the optical center off the screen axis shared by title, panel and level node
defects.direction: Center the whole CTA group (label + cost pill) on the screen's vertical axis

defects.defect: The thin outlined CTA lettering has weaker contrast and hierarchy than the otherwise bold game UI.
defects.direction: Use heavier, higher-contrast button typography once enclosed in the primary CTA.

defects.defect: Play label is low-contrast gray-on-brown and reads as disabled/watermarked
defects.direction: Raise contrast (light cream or gold fill with dark outline) so the primary CTA is the most legible element on screen

defects.defect: 'Play · Level 1' is thin low-contrast light text on mid-brown, weaker legibility than every other label on screen
defects.direction: Use the heavier outlined/shadowed game font on a contrasting button fill

defects.defect: The sparse locks and side decorations are widely separated and do not visually anchor to the central level node.
defects.direction: Tighten the progression composition or strengthen connectors, landmarks, and background structure to fill the map intentionally.

defects.defect: Empty brown strip below the Play row reads as leftover space, making margins between Play and nav bar feel unbalanced versus the tighter gaps above
defects.direction: Tighten the gap or shift the Play button down so vertical margins between title, panels, Play and nav bar are consistent
defects.region: Band between Play row and nav bar, y≈1260-1330

defects.defect: Name chips sit on the panel's bottom edge with almost no bottom padding, and Bastion/Sage chips are not centered under their sprites' optical mass
defects.direction: Add bottom padding inside the panel and center each chip under its sprite

defects.defect: The four currency pills have unequal widths (energy pill ~25% wider than the others)
defects.direction: Equalize pill widths and distribute them on a uniform grid so the row reads as one consistent set

defects.defect: Hero panel has a tall empty cream band above the characters (~110px), leaving the sprites bottom-weighted in the frame
defects.direction: Reduce the panel's top padding or raise the sprite row so the characters sit optically centered in the panel

defects.defect: Large flat diagonal-stripe areas flanking the map and below it are empty, so the middle of the screen reads unfinished
defects.direction: Fill with a framed map panel and decorative parallax/vignette so no bare stripe field remains
defects.region: Mid background, y≈1130-1330 and left/right of map
